description:
Sarsabz ke taraqi pasand kashtkaar Mohammad Fayyaz Chattha Wald Hamid Nasir Chattha Ki Kahaani! Jo Saliha-sal sey Sarsabz Nitrophos aur CAN Gawara ka estimaal kar ke apni Dhaan ki fasal sey 10 feesad sey bhi Zayada Paidawaar hasial ker rahey hein.

Kissan Tera Ehsaan, Sarsabz Pakistan!

#SalamKissan #SarsabzPakistan
